description: cfd_2d_6dof_fish_x198_amr with the refit after the projection (X 198 2): after the level projection of each stage of the finest level the fish takes the rigid-body motion of the projected velocity of its patches (cfd_amr::body_refit, sixdof_obj_cfd::momentum_refit_set), the patches are forced again (momentum_rk::amr_forcing) and projected again. With the SSP-RK3 of the mesh refinement X 198 1 swims 9 % slow at N 47 0.25; X 198 2 as the low-storage RK3 of the uniform grid (Fish Swimming validation 06).
covers: a second pr_level of the finest level
